errors.evidence: The color described as "светлосин" (light blue) corresponds to the category "До известна степен". In the chart, this category is represented by a medium shade of blue/teal, while the lighter shade corresponds to the category "В много малка степен".

errors.text_span: „В много малка степен“ (светлосин с по-светъл тон)
errors.evidence: The description of the color for "В много малка степен" as "светлосин с по-светъл тон" (light blue with a lighter tone) is confusing and stems from the previous error of incorrectly identifying the color for "До известна степен". The color for "В много малка степен" is a distinct light blue/teal shade, not just a lighter version of the incorrectly described medium shade.
